reference: Unchanged selected six-model stoppage consensus; earlier broadcast replacement and source-screen results remain preserved and unpromoted.
objective_history: Earlier prospective plans required buffered+.04 and none passed. The user's continuing objective is maximum score. This new prospective step may advance a smaller primary gain only under stricter paired secondary and false-possession protections. A promotion under this plan must not be described as passing the earlier+.04 criterion; report substantial and incremental gates separately.
hypotheses_ranked: The source-defined interval contains a short correct core but can start too early. Intersecting source and canonical learned support may retain the core and reject unsupported source tails.

Two opposite live flanks unnecessarily reject new control adjacent to a reference D boundary. Require at least one opposite flank and allow D or same-team anchoring on the other, while retaining the no-D-overlap rule.
A closure change alone may be insufficient. Compare it with source/learned intersection using each of the two unchanged joint heads.
data: Reuse strictly aligned label-free broadcast features and original seed42 joint-head OOF outputs. No new model fitting or input data; no GT endpoints, media, private labels, annotations or manual frame patches in inference.

inference.source: Unchanged source generation from BROADCAST_SOURCE_INTERVAL_PLAN, fixed11-frame conditional source averaging and penalty3, inside contiguous observed broadcast-ball episodes only.
inference.intersection: For intersection methods, split each source-predicted H/A run into contiguous components where the canonical joint-replacement prediction agrees with its owner. Closure-only methods retain the full source run.
inference.gates: Each resulting proposal8..125frames, non-edge in overall decode block, mean source probability>=.65,>=3 instantaneous same-camera exclusive contacts (distance<2m, advantage>.5m), no referenceD overlap, and>=.5 canonical learned agreement. At least one neighboring13-frame reference flank has majority opposite ownership; the other has majority opposite, D or same-owner control. All gates read unchanged reference/learned predictions. Reject proposals wholly enclosed by an opposite reference run8..250frames. Preserve reference D exactly.
inference.context: No additional physical context beyond the existing broadcast feature construction<=175tactical frames; original block/half inference resets remain unchanged.

confirmation: Freeze at most one unchanged seed42 screen finalist before seeds43/44. Refit only the corresponding broadcast joint head per existing eligible folds, verify seed42 parity, and apply identical canonical/source inference. Full reproducible CSV, official scoring, source/model/cache checks and independent review precede promotion.

promotion.all_pairs: No stitched primary or mean-short-IoU regression; MacroF1>=reference-.001; no lost previously mostly recovered short run; identical D masks; official IoU.5 spurious possession count<=reference.
promotion.each_buffered_seed: Primary gain>=.01, at least one additional short IoU>=.5 match, and fewer official IoU.5 missed possessions.
promotion.each_protocol: Strictly positive mean primary gain across seeds.
promotion.substantial_label: Report separately whether buffered+.04 holds for every seed. Failing this label does not satisfy the older substantial-gain plans.
promotion.selection: Largest minimum primary gain across protocols, then larger mean short IoU, then fewer spurious possessions. If no unchanged finalist passes, preserve current model. Record every clipped-block regression.

limitations: Adaptive follow-up motivated by inspected public errors. Paired protocols/seeds are dependent and do not establish independent/private full-match accuracy or maximum score. Agreement sources may share errors; real correspondence is verified by physical consistency, not a supplied alignment answer key.
